title: The Response Architecture Is Moving. The Exposure Is Multiplying.
method: AI-assisted cross-source synthesis with direct links to originating publishers. Reviewed against a six-item gate including two primary institutional sources.

items.headline: African Union and Uganda sign the host agreement for the African Humanitarian Agency.
items.whyItMatters: The agreement supplies a legal base, a host state and a stated financing commitment for a continent-led response institution. The unresolved point is whether the tranches, staffing and depot network arrive on the announced timetable.

items.headline: EAC adopts a regional El Niño emergency plan with November implementation deadlines.
items.whyItMatters: The plan converts a regional climate warning into named coordination structures and near-term deadlines. Financing remains to be mobilized, so operational readiness cannot yet be inferred from adoption alone.

items.headline: Somalia’s Supreme Court rules the president’s term has expired.
items.whyItMatters: The ruling creates a judicial timetable for a political dispute already linked to armed tension in Mogadishu. Enforcement, interim authority and the presidency’s response remain unresolved.

items.headline: Eight people are killed in a suspected al-Shabaab attack in northeastern Kenya.
items.whyItMatters: The attack shows how insecurity can directly interrupt infrastructure work and civilian mobility along the Kenya–Somalia border. Attribution remains suspected rather than judicially established.

items.headline: Congo’s Ebola outbreak surpasses 11,000 confirmed cases.
items.whyItMatters: The scale makes regional containment capacity—not only national case management—the operative test. The totals are government data and may change as surveillance and delayed reporting continue.

items.headline: Kenya releases its last Ebola patient and starts the 42-day disease-free countdown.
items.whyItMatters: Kenya’s containment progress contrasts with the expanding outbreak in Congo and shows the value of contact tracing around an imported cluster. Disease-free status is conditional on completing 42 days without another case.
